evidence.title: PDFx — shadcn/ui for React PDFs | Copy-Paste PDF Components

name: PDFx
summary: Copy-paste React PDF components built on @react-pdf/renderer — 24 components with a theme system and CLI.
description: A shadcn/ui-style library of copy-paste PDF components for React, built on @react-pdf/renderer with no runtime dependency on PDFx. Components are namespaced so they don't collide with shadcn/ui's heading and table, installed through a CLI (npx pdfx-cli add <component>) and customized with a theme system; invoice and report block templates are included.
contains: built on @react-pdf/renderer, no runtime dependency on PDFx
namespaced to coexist with shadcn/ui (heading, table)
